GRIDLOGIC: HARDWARE/SOFTWARE CODESIGN FOR DEEP GRID VISIBILITY AND SECURITY

PROPOSE GRIDLOGIC, A FRAMEWORK FOR CYBER-PHYSICAL SECURITY BY DESIGN THAT WILL IMPEDE ATTACKERS OR MALICIOUS OPERATORS FROM TAKING ACTIONS THAT ARE DETRIMENTAL TO THE ELECTRICITY GRID. THE PROJECT HAS THE FOLLOWING OBJECTIVES: DEVELOP AND IMPLEMENT A CONTROL SYSTEM CAPABLE OF BLOCKING DETRIMENTAL ACTIONS OR TRAJECTORY OPERATIONAL ACTION BY AN EXTERNAL ATTACKER AND EVEN IN THE CASE OF AN AUTHORIZED INSIDER, IMPLEMENT AND DEMONSTRATE HARDWARE-BASED DATA ENCRYPTION AS A SECOND LAYER (I.E., IN ADDITION TO ANY NETWORK-BASED ENCRYPTION) FOR FIELD CONTROL DEVICES, DEVELOP AND DEMONSTRATE DEEP COMMUNICATION NETWORK CAPABILITY WITH ANOMALY DETECTION, AND DEVELOP AND DEMONSTRATE AI-BASED, SYSTEM-LEVEL CYBER-PHYSICAL SECURITY ASSESSMENT.

PHYSICS-AWARE AND AUTOMATED VULNERABILITY DISCOVERY AND PATCHING IN HETEROGENEOUS DISTRIBUTED ENERGY RESOURCES AGAINST CYBER ATTACKS

DEVELOP AND DEMONSTRATE DERGUARD, AN AUTOMATED DISTRIBUTED ENERGY RESOURCE (DER) DEVICE SECURITY VETTING AND HARDENING FRAMEWORK. DEVELOP TECHNIQUES TO ANALYZE INDIVIDUAL DISTRIBUTED ENERGY RESOURCE (DER) DEVICES AND THEIR FUNCTIONAL BENIGN AND POTENTIALLY MALICIOUS IMPACT ON SYSTEM-WIDE POWER GRID OPERATIONS.

DEVELOP A SECURE QUANTUM POWER PROTECTION COORDINATION TECHNIQUE FOR THE POWER GRID AND SHALL USE QUANTUM ENTANGLEMENT TO INDICATE WHETHER RELAYS SHOULD RESPOND TO TRIP MESSAGES IN THEIR CONFIGURED COORDINATION WITHIN THE POWER GRID.

PKC AND PUF-BASED AUTHENTICATION AND SECRET KEY ESTABLISHMENT IN SMART GRID

THE OBJECTIVES OF THIS PROJECT ARE TO INTEGRATE INNOVATIVE SCALABLE SECURE AUTHENTICATION TECHNIQUES, BLENDED WITH KEY ESTABLISHMENT, AND SECURE COMMUNICATION MECHANISMS FOR THE SMART GRID.
